description: This file defines the class DeleteSubjectResponse, which represents the response to a DeleteSubject command within a policies management context. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters and JSON, extracting resource paths, appending payloads for serialization, and handling object equality and string representation.

classes.name: DeleteSubjectResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a DeleteSubject command, containing metadata and payload related to the deleted subject, and providing various factory methods for creation and deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance using PolicyId, Label, SubjectId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path for this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the payload fields into a JSON object builder, respecting the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
